paragraphs.text: The committee met on Tuesday to talk about the annual outing and where it should be held this year. Several members suggested the beach because it is easy to reach and affordable for everyone.
Others preferred the mountains because the weather is cooler and the views are better for photos. After a long discussion the group agreed to ask all employees to vote before making a final decision.
The results of the vote will be shared next week together with the budget and the schedule for the day.
